integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic realism, a wide eye-level shot preserves the exact composition of <Picture 1>: three women centered in a row inside a vast derelict warehouse — the short-black-haired woman in black crop top, cargo pants and heavy boots gripping a handgun lowered at hip level on the left; the long-orange-haired cheerleader in an orange-and-white uniform resting a baseball bat over her shoulder in the center; the short-black-bobbed woman in a purple sequined jacket and hot pants holding a samurai sword diagonally with both hands on the right. Rusted machinery, barrels, hanging chains, broken grid windows, wet reflective concrete, drifting smoke, and flickering warm work lamps against cool blue-grey window light fill the space. Handheld camera with slight shake holds the framing as lamp light flickers and silhouettes of zombies in varied tattered clothing begin emerging from dark doorways and behind machinery at the frame edges; the three women tighten their grips and shift into combat stances. [Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the shot cuts to a handheld close-up of the woman in black raising the handgun from her hip to eye level, breathing heavily, eyes focused ahead; she fires multiple rounds — muzzle flashes strobe, shell casings eject, and a zombie recoils backward with realistic physics. [Shot 3] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a handheld close-up of the orange-haired cheerleader swinging the baseball bat into a lunging zombie, the swing rendered with motion blur as debris and dust burst on impact. [Shot 4] At 00:04.500, the shot cuts to a handheld close-up of the woman in purple sequins slashing the samurai sword in a fast arc through a zombie, sequins glinting in the flickering light, motion blur trailing the blade. [Shot 5] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a handheld tracking shot following the trio as they push forward through the horde in sync — firing, swinging, slashing — while varied zombies of different heights, decay states, and tattered outfits swarm in from both sides. [Shot 6] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to an over-the-shoulder shot from behind the team, a mass of zombies rushing toward the camera in chaotic, fast movement with heavy motion blur. [Shot 7] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a handheld shot of the team sprinting toward a dimly lit exit doorway at the far end of the warehouse, zombies closing in behind them. [Shot 8] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to the final hero shot: the three women silhouetted against the bright exit light as they dash out of the doorway, zombie hands and shapes closing in from the shadows just behind them.

overall_soundscape: Gunshots crack with sharp echoes through the warehouse, punctuated by the whistling swing and heavy impact of a baseball bat, the metallic slice of a blade, and guttural zombie snarls. Boots pound the wet concrete, shell casings clatter, chains sway overhead, and flickering lamps buzz as the team sprints toward the exit.
